pages.text: Sneak-right-click the $(item)Golden Eye$() to lock it onto the nearest structure: villages, strongholds, monuments, mansions and more. The tooltip shows its target.
Right-click to throw it: it flies toward that structure like an Eye of Ender, then drops back as an item.
Each throw uses some durability. Recharge it in a crafting grid with $(item)Ender Pearls$().
